vague.zh: 玩具车冲上斜坡,越过坡顶,在空中翻转一圈后正面朝上落在坡后。
vague.en: The toy car is pushed up a ramp, clears the top, turns over in the air and lands upright just past it.

quantitative.zh: 玩具车以 2.7 m/s 冲上 20 度的光滑沥青坡,越过坡顶,在空中转完一圈后正面朝上落在坡后,行程 1.05 m,停在 x=-0.73。
quantitative.en: The toy car is pushed at 2.7 m/s up the 20 deg slick-asphalt ramp, clears the top, completes its rotation in the air, and lands upright just past the ramp, ending at x=-0.73 after 1.05 m of travel.
